regions.merged_text: Mary Mecameracki - 34 - of Hamtram. - infantile paralysis since 8 - for six yrs. could not walk a step. Then was told a second time while sitting in back yard; "Walk. Take sticks and walk." At first it was extremely difficult. Now has crutches and can get along ... works two weeks a month only bread-winner.
